UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Eastbourne Bandstand 1: Fiona Bruce visits the seafront at Eastbourne, where items include a collection of pottery, a signalling lamp used during D-Day and rare images of Marilyn Monroe. S36 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: The Green Planet
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Water Worlds: David Attenborough presents a guide to the world of plants that grow in water, including a river in Brazil, where the plants have created their own atmosphere. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Fastback / Norton: The team's first purchase is a 1972 VW Fastback, and the second project sees them pick up a 40-year-old police bike. S6 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Opel Manta GT/1902 Oldsmobile/Morris Oxford/Volvo Torslanda Estate: Derek collects an Opel Manta, Charlie and his mum pick up a Morris Oxford, and Paul is enthralled by a motoring relic. S14 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Elan / BMW: The team take on one of their most ambitious projects to date - a 1963 Lotus Elan Series 1. Their second project could also amaze... by showing a profit... a 90's BMW 3 series. S5 Ep6

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Morgan Plus 8/Clenet Roadster: Derek rubs shoulders with pop music royalty when he picks up a Morgan sports car; a WWII ambulance arrives at Thornton le Dale and a Ford Model T needs a new home. S5 Ep

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Ford Fiesta/Malton Forest Rally: Dave collects a Ford Fiesta XR2i that's not moved from a garage for twenty-one years and Derek picks up a 1956 Siva Tourer, made famous in Doctor Who. S10 Ep14

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: New: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Simon and Henry are in Northamptonshire to meet clock restorer Bryn and his partner, Shelley. One of the items that catches Simon's eye is a grand old clock mechanism. S9 Ep7

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Abandoned Engineering
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Castle of the Occult: Exploring a dense forest near the Czech capital of Prague that hides Houska Castle, an eerie castle rumoured to possess supernatural powers. S10 Ep8

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Shopping from Home.

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Abandoned Engineering
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Blitz Spirit: Exploring a grand structure in Hull that was reduced to rubble by Hitler's planes, Casa Albero in Italy, USS Hornet in California and the Sofia tunnels. S10 Ep10

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Abandoned Engineering
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: An American Exodus: Exploring a decrepit Liberian landmark with American origins, a desolate town in Belgium and a pioneering scientific structure in Cleveland. S10 Ep11

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Astra: A sun-bleached red Vauxhall Astra GTE gives the team a headache as they also buy a classic French moped and catch up on the restoration of a barn find Mini Cooper S. S1 Ep1
